basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer from Portland, Oregon. I recently joined Reddit to connect with communities that resonate with my interests, including music, cartoons, and sobriety. I have a passion for exploring new music genres and am a huge fan of David Sylvian and electronic music. I dislike negativity and try to maintain a positive outlook on life. In my free time, I enjoy watching animated shows like Glitch Techs with my younger siblings. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM PST. Currently, I'm single and focusing on my personal growth.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design from a local art school and have been working in the field for about 5 years. I am self-taught in music production and often experiment with creating electronic music in my home studio. My knowledge of sobriety is largely experiential, having been on and off the wagon for a couple of years.
